title: Split, cograph and threshold graph structures
abstract: Connects split partitions, cotrees and threshold creation sequences on Mathlib SimpleGraph. Proves the finite forbidden-induced-subgraph characterizations, split iff chordal and co-chordal, and completeness of cotrees and creation sequences. Supplies certificate-preserving operations, twins and nonempty union/join decompositions for cographs, maximum-clique split partitions, and induced/isomorphic transport of existing chordal elimination orders and clique trees. Classical graph theory is formalized; no new mathematical theorem, canonical certificate or recognition-time bound is claimed.

informal.SimpleGraph.isSplit_iff_forbidden_induce: A finite graph is split iff it contains no induced 2K2, C4 or C5.
informal.SimpleGraph.isSplit_iff_isChordal_and_co: A finite graph is split iff both it and its complement are chordal.
informal.SimpleGraph.isCograph_iff_nonempty_cotre: A finite graph is P4-free iff it is isomorphic to the graph of a cotree, whose constructors are empty, singleton, disjoint union and join.
informal.SimpleGraph.isThreshold_iff_isSplit_and_: A graph has a split partition with nested independent-side neighbourhoods iff it is both split and P4-free. No finiteness is required.
informal.SimpleGraph.isThreshold_iff_forbidden_in: A finite graph is threshold iff it contains no induced 2K2, C4 or P4.
informal.SimpleGraph.isThreshold_iff_nonempty_cre: A finite graph is threshold iff it is isomorphic to a graph constructed from the empty graph by successively adding an isolated or universal vertex.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsCograph.exists_twins: A finite cograph with at least two vertices has two distinct vertices with identical adjacency outside their pair, whether adjacent or not.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsCograph.exists_union_root: A finite cograph that is not preconnected admits a cotree representation with a union root and two nonempty children. This is an existence claim, not a claim about every unreduced cotree.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsCograph.exists_join_root: A preconnected finite cograph with at least two vertices admits a cotree representation with a join root and two nonempty children.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsSplit.exists_partition_wit: Every finite split graph admits a split partition whose clique part has maximum cardinality. Such a partition need not be unique.
